name: Solo Quiz
description: A multiple-choice quiz each student takes on their own device at their own pace. No race, no questions on the projector: the board shows only who has started, who has finished, and how the class did on each question. Students can begin the moment they join.
tagline: Perfect for a warm-up check, a low-pressure review, or the first five minutes while people arrive.

questions.label: Questions
questions.helper: Mark the right answer, it must match one of the choices exactly.

question.label: Question
question.placeholder: What is the capital of Australia?

default.question: What is the capital of Australia?

showAnswers.label: Show the right answer after each question
showAnswers.helper: Off: students only learn whether they were right, which keeps the answers fresh for a later class.

template.name: Solo Quiz
template.description: A quiz students take at their own pace. The projector shows progress, never the questions.

end.message: That is the quiz. Nice work, everyone.
